data.one_liner: A collection of Dart and Flutter lint rules used at iteo.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of linter rules that can be included via analysis_options.yaml. It enables all available rules by default and allows disabling or enabling specific ones.
use_when: You need a consistent linting setup for a Flutter/Dart project
You want to enforce coding standards without writing custom rules
You want to use a preconfigured set of rules that matches a team’s style
avoid_when: You prefer to write your own custom lint rules
You need a runtime library rather than compile‑time linting
strengths: Includes many experimental and custom rules
weaknesses: Requires Dart SDK 3.1 for latest version
No integration with IDEs beyond standard lint support
data.setup_notes: Add as dev_dependency and include package:linteo/analysis_options.yaml in analysis_options.yaml

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard linter set maintained by the Dart team

data.minimal_example:
// analysis_options.yaml
include: package:linteo/analysis_options.yaml
linter:
  rules:
    public_member_api_docs: true
